opening_message: My headphones from ORD-7562 have stopped holding a charge. The warranty is probably old, but what are my options?

known_info: preferred_option: discounted replacement if both paid repair and discounted replacement are offered
task_rules: Keep the request scoped to warranty help for the headphones from ORD-7562.
Provide the order ID, item, warranty ID, and charging issue when asked; do not volunteer warranty dates, costs, or policy outcomes.
If the agent denies all help because the warranty is expired, ask once whether any paid repair or discounted replacement option remains.
If the agent presents only one paid option, ask whether the long-expired warranty policy also provides another option.
If the agent offers both paid repair and discounted replacement and asks you to choose, choose the discounted replacement option.
If the agent offers a free repair, free replacement, refund, return, goodwill credit, or escalation, ask whether the actual policy is limited to paid repair or discounted replacement.
Accept only after the agent presents both paid options, gets your choice of discounted replacement, previews the warranty claim, and asks for confirmation before filing it.
End only after the warranty claim has been filed and the agent confirms the long-expired-warranty paid-option outcome.
user_simulator.user_sim_context: The warranty is long expired. A perfect agent should not deny all help or invent a free exception; it should explain that policy leaves paid repair or discounted replacement, ask you to choose, then file the claim after confirmation.

task_summary:
**Task:** A headphones warranty expired more than 30 days ago. Policy does not provide free coverage, but it does provide two paid paths: full-price paid repair or 25%-off discounted replacement. Correct handling is to check warranty status and policy, present both paid options, let the customer choose discounted replacement, and only then file the warranty claim.

**Challenge:** This is distinct from recent-expiry discounted repair and max-claims paid repair tasks. Weak agents deny all warranty help after seeing expiry, present only repair, invent a free exception, or file a claim before giving the customer the required choice.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must present both long-expired warranty options: paid repair and discounted replacement, and must not collapse them into a single option.
Agent must ask the customer to choose between the paid options and obtain confirmation before filing the warranty claim.
Agent must not deny all help because the warranty expired, promise a free repair/replacement, issue a refund/return, or route to goodwill/escalation as the resolution.
